llm_context.input_title: fix(core): use case-insensitive check for RCE keyword in vulnerability description
llm_context.input_body: No body provided in issue description.

generated_output.summary: Fix a case-sensitivity bug in the vulnerability remote code execution (RCE) detection where `Vulnerability.IsRCE()` checks for the exact uppercase string "RCE" against `v.Description` rather than utilizing the lowercased description string, leading to under-reporting of vulnerabilities.
generated_output.root_cause_analysis: The keyword check was implemented using the original mixed-case `v.Description` with an uppercase literal "RCE" instead of using the precomputed lowercased `desc` string like other keyword checks in the same context.

step_by_step_plan.title: Inspect Vulnerability.IsRCE implementation
step_by_step_plan.description: Inspect symbol IsRCE in file core/cautils/datastructuresmethods.go and verify how the description string is converted to lowercase and where strings.Contains is used.

step_by_step_plan.title: Fix case-sensitivity in IsRCE check
step_by_step_plan.description: Modify strings.Contains(v.Description, "RCE") in core/cautils/datastructuresmethods.go to check against the lowercased desc variable using strings.Contains(desc, "rce").

step_by_step_plan.title: Add regression tests for case-insensitive RCE detection
step_by_step_plan.description: Update core/cautils/datastructuresmethods_test.go to add test cases covering lowercase "rce", mixed-case "Rce", and uppercase "RCE" descriptions.

step_by_step_plan.description: Execute the test suite in core/cautils to ensure that all IsRCE test cases pass successfully without regressions.

structured_concepts.short_explanation: Ensuring text searches do not fail due to differing capitalization (uppercase vs. lowercase).
structured_concepts.why_it_matters: Real-world vulnerability descriptions vary wildly in capitalization; failing to account for case leads to missed detections and false negatives.
structured_concepts.connection_to_issue: The issue stems from checking for uppercase "RCE" on a mixed-case string instead of utilizing the lowercased description.

structured_concepts.short_explanation: Reusing pre-processed or sanitized variables throughout a function to maintain consistency and prevent bugs.
structured_concepts.why_it_matters: When a function transforms an input once (like lowercasing), subsequent checks should use that transformed version to avoid accidental inconsistencies.
structured_concepts.connection_to_issue: The function already created a lowercased `desc` variable but failed to use it for the RCE check.

common_pitfalls: Hardcoding uppercase literal strings when searching parsed or natural-language descriptions.
Forgetting to update or add unit test cases covering mixed-case vulnerability descriptions.
